analysis_rules.label: Page has no confident industry role
analysis_rules.remediation: Leave the role unassigned and expose alternatives.

analysis_rules.label: Role-required sections are missing or weak
analysis_rules.remediation: Add only missing role-specific sections supported by current evidence.

analysis_rules.label: Customer journey has unanswered required questions
analysis_rules.remediation: Create or improve visible answers using verified facts and the appropriate next action.

analysis_rules.label: Page lacks the next action expected for its role
analysis_rules.remediation: Add a role-appropriate next action and ensure the target is reachable and measurable.

analysis_rules.label: Structured data conflicts with visible content
analysis_rules.remediation: Make structured data match visible, current and scoped facts; remove unsupported properties.

analysis_rules.label: Page lacks useful role-aligned structured data
analysis_rules.remediation: Add only relevant Schema.org types and properties that mirror visible content.

analysis_rules.label: Time-sensitive knowledge lacks a temporal state
analysis_rules.remediation: Assign current, historical, future or unknown before using the source as current authority.

analysis_rules.label: Current assertions conflict within overlapping scope
analysis_rules.remediation: Preserve every source, group the contradiction, and block authoritative generation until reviewed.

analysis_rules.label: Sensitive numeric or time-varying claim lacks direct evidence
analysis_rules.remediation: Remove, qualify or request the unsupported value; never infer it from adjacent content.

analysis_rules.label: Important page is weakly connected to evidence and next steps
analysis_rules.remediation: Add relevant internal links to evidence, related roles and the next journey step.

analysis_rules.label: Journey outcome has no compatible measurement event
analysis_rules.remediation: Map a compatible event or display unavailable; never display missing measurement as zero.

analysis_rules.label: Regulated claim requires qualified human review
analysis_rules.remediation: Block authoritative output until a qualified reviewer approves the scoped claim.
